title: Cohesive credential-resilience layer and stream-iterator ergonomics refactor
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduce CredentialCascade and SessionLease across SDKs; unify stream iterator semantics and ergonomics; small API shims maintain backward compatibility; bump Python to 2.8.0, TypeScript to 3.2.0, Go to 1.15.0; recommended migration notes included.
description: Motivation: teams integrating long-lived streaming calls saw edge cases where credential refreshes raced with in-flight KV/prefix cache warmups, leading to transient 401s or stream resets. This PR introduces a cohesive credential-resilience layer and tightens stream iterator ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs so that session renewals, backoff profiles, and cancellation semantics are consistent. What changed: 1) Credential layer: added CredentialCascade (ordered fallback chain) and SessionLease (short-lived lease token + proactive refresh) implemented in each SDK and exposed as a lightweight surface. The layer centralizes token rotation, retry window coordination, and a small in-memory cache with TTL and jittered refresh. 2) Backoff and retry: standardized retry profiles (fast-warmup, stable, conservative) and plumbed them into streaming reconnection logic so operators can choose deterministic tradeoffs. 3) Streaming ergonomics: TypeScript: introduced StreamController with cancel(), pause(), resume() and a typed iterator facade; Python: added session.lease() context manager and an async generator that yields typed events and supports a .cancel() handle; Go: added context-aware StreamCursor and ResettableIterator that exposes a ResumeWith(ctx) hook. 4) Compatibility shims: old entry points are preserved via thin adapters to avoid breaking customers; deprecation warnings added. 5) Examples & docs: upgraded streaming examples, added migration guide and a compatibility page. 6) Version bumps: python 2.8.0, typescript 3.2.0, go 1.15.0. Migration notes: prefer SessionLease for multi-request workflows; to opt out keep using the previous token provider but expect more manual refresh handling. CI and testing: added cross-SDK integration tests that exercise long-running streams with credential rotations and simulated network glitches. Impact: reduces transient auth failures during stream reconnects and makes retry behavior predictable across SDKs. Rollout plan: merged to main, changelog published, will backport critical fixes to release/2026-01 if any regressions are found.
commits: feat: add CredentialCascade and SessionLease abstractions across SDKs
refactor(ts,py,go): unify streaming iterator semantics and implement StreamController/StreamCursor
chore: add integration tests for rotating credentials during long-lived streams
fix(py): handle race between token refresh and iterator cancellation
docs: migration guide and upgrade notes
ci: expand SDK matrix to include streaming+auth scenarios
discussion: Initial review flagged potential perf impact of synchronous token refresh in hot paths; switched to optimistic background refresh with a single-flight gate. Diego requested clearer naming for 'Lease' vs 'Session'; renamed internal types and added docstrings. Marta asked for tighter test coverage around cancellation during refresh; added async test harness and a deterministic scheduler for Python. Liam approved after CI stabilized and perf regression was shown to be <1% p50. Several minor nits fixed in follow-ups before merge.
tests_summary: Unit: all SDK unit tests passed. Integration: added three new long-running stream tests per SDK simulating token rotation mid-stream. Flaky failures: initial Python lint (black) and a Go race detector hit were fixed in subsequent commits. End-to-end matrix (linux, macos, node14/16, go1.18) completed green.
merge_outcome: Merged into main with squash. CHANGELOG entry added under Unreleased. Cherrypick candidate created for release/2026-01. Package releases queued: python wheel build + publish, typescript npm publish, go module tag.
